_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Collect 4 Frostmaul Shards for Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
Collect 2 Pristine Yeti Horns for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
Speak with Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Vale off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.

In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector. Be warned, this gem is one of the most rare crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in…
Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.
Retrieve the Warchief's Orders and return them to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

Free nine Servants of Razelikh, three Servants of Sevine, three Servants of Allistarj, and three Servants of Grol. Return to the Fallen Hero when your task is complete. You must remain within close proximity of the stones or the process wi…
Open the chest and claim your reward.
Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.
Find out what became of Lieutenant Kirith.
Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde with your findings.
Speak with Loramus Thalipedes in Azshara.
Listen to the Fallen Hero of the Horde tell his story.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.
Travel to the eastern part of Winterspring and speak with Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
Wait for Galvan to finish forging the weaponry.
Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

Slay Grol the Destroyer, Lady Sevine, and Archmage Allistarj. From their corpses take the Amulet of Grol, the Amulet of Sevine, and the Amulet of Allistarj. Remember to USE your Enchanted Azsharite Fel Weaponry to weaken the triad. They ca…

o.t: Teleport to the top of the mountain.
Teleport to the top of the mountain.
Use the Ward of the Defiler to summon Razelikh.

quests.t: Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the…
Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs for Umi Rumplesnicker in Everlook.
Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.
Enter Blackrock Depths and track down Lord Incendius. Slay him and return any source of information you may find to Thunderheart.
Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.
Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth. You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

o.t: Use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'gar's corpse.

quests.t: Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay Bael'Gar. You only know that the giant resides inside Blackrock Depths. Remember to use the Altered Black Dragonflight Molt on Bael'Gar's remains to capture the Fiery Essence. Return the Encased Fiery Es…

Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.
Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus. You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

Find and slay Golem Lord Argelmach. Return his head to Lotwil. You will also need to collect 10 Intact Elemental Cores from the Ragereaver Golems and Warbringer Constructs protecting Argelmach. You know this because you are psychic.

quests.n: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
quests.t: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody. You will also…

Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress. When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Bla…
Bring the Heart of the Mountain to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.
Travel to Blackrock Depths and slay General Angerforge! Return to Warlord Goretooth when the task is complete.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Bring Ribbly's Head to Yuka Screwspigot in the Burning Steppes.
Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Slay Halycon, pack mistress of the Bloodaxe worg.

o.t: Use the Empty Worg Pup Cage to capture it.

quests.t: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.
Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.
Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.
Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler. By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.
Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.
Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.
Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.
Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread.…

In order to create the Leggings of Arcana, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Frostwhisper's Embalming Fluid. You…

In order to create the Breastplate of Bloodthirst, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 5 Arcanite Bars; 5 Skin of Shadow. You will a…
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.
Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.
Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!
Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.
Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.
Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained. You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.…
Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands. Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will…

Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains. Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will…

Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale. Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts. The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leat…
Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.
Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it: Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring) Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris) Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater) When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.
Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.
Find the Black Guard Swordsmith in Stratholme and destroy him. Recover the Insignia of the Black Guard and return to Seril Scourgebane.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Find Pamela Redpath in Darrowshire.
Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.
Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.
Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook.
Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.
Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.
Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.
Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander. Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture. Should you succeed,…
Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes. Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.
Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.
Bring 3 Arcanite Bar to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Read Mor'zul's Instructions. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
